svg.title: Personal Contact Manager -- Main User Flow

g.text: Personal Contact Manager -- Main User Flow
(an empty term returns every contact this user owns)
Type a term, pick a field
Open a card, change the fields
{ userId, id, firstName, lastName, phone, email }
Re-run the search and re-render the list
Show the message the API returned
Every request above goes through one helper,
The API always answers HTTP 200 and reports
failure in the "error" field, so the success
path is where errors have to be caught.
